name: runeglow-monorepo
description: Runeglow: high-craft UI effects, as a framework-free core with adapters for Svelte, React, Vue and custom elements.

scripts.build: pnpm build:lib && pnpm registry && pnpm --filter site build
scripts.registry: node scripts/build-registry.mjs && cd apps/site && pnpm dlx shadcn-svelte@1.8.1 registry build
scripts.deploy:site: pnpm build && cd apps/site && pnpm dlx wrangler@latest deploy
